featured_reviews.name: danish shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is absolutely unacceptable and extremely frustrating service. Every single time I place an online order, the delivery takes more than an hour, even though your outlet is hardly five minutes away from my house. This is not a one-time issue—it has happened repeatedly, and honestly, I am tired of facing the same problem again and again.

If you already know that you cannot manage timely delivery, why do you continue to accept online orders and give false expectations to customers? It feels completely irresponsible and misleading. Customers place orders trusting your service, but instead of receiving medicune on time, we are left waiting endlessly with no proper updates or accountability.

Such poor service reflects a serious lack of management and concern for customer satisfaction. I do not understand how this kind of delay is justified for such a short distance. This experience has been extremely disappointing and has wasted my time and patience. If this issue cannot be fixed, then please stop accepting delivery orders rather than delivering such consistently bad service.

Regards,

featured_reviews.review_text: They have everything other than medicines required. Four people managing the counter at their own pace. featured_reviews.name: Nisha Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was searching for this medicine at many places but couldn’t find it anywhere. When I visited the Wellness Andheri store I met Janab Sir. He gave me a commitment that he would arrange it within 4 hours and he actually did. He also delivered it to me free of cost.
Thank you so much for the excellent support and service.

featured_reviews.name: Zara Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Horrible service.. never deliver on time..act like they are the ONLY business in town ...especially when they are into medicine and first aid ..they should be prompt but they make u wait for hrs and hrs even a whole day for simple medicine saying they are always busy.. never order from them.

featured_reviews.review_text: The staff at the store is extremely slow. I was the only customer and it took very long to get my medicine. featured_reviews.name: manisha agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came here to give them rating. Had I seen before that they r 2.4 I wouldn’t have even called for the meds. They will give u funny reasons like medicine to get delivered to them take 2-3 months. Therefore they r giving old stock. But hello! How do other medical stores around u give the same product of the current month.
Worst medical store! Always reason.

featured_reviews.name: Padmanabh PBG
featured_reviews.review_text: I am very disappointed with the delivery service. The medicine is still not delivered on time. I will think twice before ordering from here again.
